k.v: अस्त्री कुशं कुथो दर्भः पवित्रमथ कत्तृणम्. पौरसौगन्धिकध्यामदेवजग्धकरौहिषम्.।

m: रौक्म mf(ई)n. (fr. रुक्म) golden, adorned with gold, Mn.; MBh. &c.
रौक्मिणेय m. ‘descendant of Rukmiṇī’, N. of Pradyumna, MBh.
a: रौक्मिणेयः — N. of Pradyumna, son of Rukmiṇī.

m: रौक्षायण m. (also pl.) id., ib.
रौक्ष-चित्त mfn. (fr. रूक्ष-च्˚) harsh-tempered, Divyāv.
रौक्षक m. (also pl.) patr. Pravar.

harshness, cruelty, uncouthness, MBh.; Ragh.
a: रौक्ष्यं — 1 Hardness, dryness, aridity. --2 Roughness, harshness, cruelty; प्रतिषेधरौक्ष्यं R. 5. 58; विदेश˚ 14. 58.

m: रौमायण mfn. (fr. 1. रोमन्) g. पक्षादि.

m: रौम m. (fr. रुम) N. of a man, Rājat.
(pl.) = रौम्य, VP.

रौमकीय mfn. g. कृशाश्वादि.

s: klI, SAmBarilavaRam । tatparyyAyaH । vasukama 2 । ityamaraH ॥ “rumA nAma nadI lavaRAkaraH tatra BavaM rOmakam । QaDe kAditi zRaH rOmaM tataH svArTe kaH rOmakam .” iti tawwIkAyAM BarataH ॥ (paryyAyo'sya yaTA, -- “SAkamBarIyaM kaTitaM guqAKyaM rOmakantaTA ॥” iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvaKaRqe praTame BAge ॥)

Roman, spoken by the inhabitants of the Roman empire, Col.
derived or coming from the astronomer Romaka, Cat.
a: रौमक — a. Roman. --कं A kind of salt.

k.v: सैन्धवोऽस्त्री शीतशिवं माणिमन्थं च सिन्धुजे। रौमकं वसुकं पाक्यं विडं च कृतके द्वयम्.।

m: रौमक—लवण n. id., L.
रौम—लवण n. = prec. n., L.
रौम्य n. N. of partic. evil demons in the service of Śiva, MBh. (cf. रौम).

रौप्या f. N. of a place, MBh.
रौप्यायण m. (also pl.) patr. Saṃskārak.

रौप्य n. silver, GāruḍaP.
a: रौप्य — a. Made of silver, silver, like silver. --प्यं Silver.

m: रौप्यक mfn. silvery, silver, Hcat.

रौप्य—मय mf(ई)n. consisting or made of silver, Hariv.; Rājat.
रौप्य—नाभ m. N. of a Rākṣasa, VP.
रौप्य—रुक्म-मय mf(ई)n. consisting or made of silver and gold, MBh.

s: puM, (rururjjantuviSezastasyAyamiti । ruru + aR .) narakaviSezaH । GoraH । iti medinI । ve, 49 ॥ Adyasya vivaraRaM yaTA, -- “rOrave kUwasAkzI tu yAti yaScAnftI naraH । tasya svarUpaM vadato rOravasya niSAmaya ॥ yojanAnAM sahasre dve rOravo hi pramARataH । jAnumAtrapramARantu tatra SvaBraM sudustaram ॥ tatrANgAracayo yena kftaM tadDaraRIsamam । jAjvalyatAtitIvreRa tApitAmbaraBUminA ॥ tanmaDye pApakarmmARaM vimuYcanti yamAnugAH । sa dahyamAnastIvreRa vahninA tena DAvati ॥ pade pade ca pAdo'sya SIryyate jAyate punaH । ahorAtreRodDaraRaM pAdanyAsaM sa gacCati । evaM sahasraM vistIrRe yojanAnAM vimucyate ॥” iti mArkaRqeyapurARe pitAputtrasaMvAdanAmADyAyaH ॥ (taTAca devIBAgavate । 8 । 22 । 8-11 । “etanmamAhamiti yo BUtadroheRa kevalam । puzRAti pratyahaM svIyakuwumbaM kAryyalampawaH ॥ etadvihAya cAtrEva svASuBena patediha । rOrave nAma narake sarvvasattvaBayAvahe ॥ iha loke'munA ye tu hiMsitA jantavaH purA । ta eva ruravo BUtvA paratra pIqayanti tam ॥ tasmAdrOravamityAhuH purARajYA maniziRaH । ruruH sarpAdapi krUro janturuktaH purAtanEH ॥”)

tri, caYcalaH । DarttaH GoraH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (rurormfgasyedamiti । aR । mfgasambanDini ca । yaTA, manuH । 2 । 41 । “kArzRarOravavAstAni carmmARi brahmacAriRaH । vasIrannAnupUrvveRa SARakzOmAvikAni ca ॥”)

m: रौरव mf(ई)n. (fr. रुरु) coming from or made of the skin of the deer called Ruru, GṛŚrS.; MBh. &c.
fearful, L.
unsteady, dishonest, L.

N. of the fifth Kalpa (q.v.)
a savage, monster, W.

N. of various Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.
a: रौरव — a. (वी f.) 1 Made of the hide of Ruru; R. 3. 31. --2 Dreadful, terrible. --3 Fraudulent, dishonest. --वः 1 A savage. --2 N. of one of the hells; Ms. 4. 88.
